sources.title: InternVL3 (Zhu et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Native joint multimodal+text pre-training (single stage, no post-hoc text-LLM retrofit) resolving post-hoc alignment complexity; V2PE extended multimodal contexts; SFT + MPO post-training; test-time scaling; 1B-78B family; 78B 72.2 MMMU open-SOTA (report-date, vendor-measured) competitive with 4o/3.5-Sonnet/Gemini-2.5-Pro with strong pure-language retention; weights + training data to be released.
Paradigm contrast vs Qwen staged bridge/extend recipe: native-joint vs staged — the anti-Qwen-only structural exhibit (not popularity).
claims.context: Edition-level analytical synthesis by the Work operator (lineage/selection/boundary/contract judgment, not a literal statement of the cited source); structural home for edition rationale.

claims.text: Architecture follows ViT-MLP-LLM: InternViT-300M (1B-14B models) or InternViT-6B (38B/78B) with Qwen2.5 (0.5B-72B) or InternLM3-8B bases (no instruction-tuned initialization), joined by a randomly initialized two-layer MLP projector; pixel-unshuffle cuts visual tokens to one quarter so each 448x448 tile yields 256 tokens, with dynamic-resolution tiling extended to multi-image and video.

V2PE assigns position indices recursively with +1 per text token but +δ<1 per visual token (Eqs.1-3); during training δ is sampled per image (held constant within an image) from {1,1/2,...,1/256} (Eq.4), and chosen at inference by sequence length to stay inside the context window; δ=1 reverts to standard encoding. Visual tokens thus spend less positional budget, extending multimodal context without dropping tokens (unlike pooling compression).
claims.context: arXiv:2504.10479v3 §2.1 Variable Visual Position Encoding, Eqs.(1)-(4).

claims.text: SFT grows 16.3M→21.7M samples (tools/3D/GUI/long-context/video/diagrams/CoT added) retaining random JPEG compression, square-loss reweighting and multimodal packing; MPO trains all models on ~300K pairs with weighted preference/quality/generation losses (Eq.9); test-time Best-of-N uses the VisualPRM-8B critic; the extended InternEVO framework (data/tensor/sequence/pipeline parallelism, dynamic visual-language load balancing, head+sequence parallel) supports sequences up to 32K tokens.

limitations.text: Vendor-measured evals at this read level (G05); 3.5-series supersession checks belong to later stages.
